items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...My mother was named Ella Mae Bird. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Ella Mae Bird. Where? She was from Bugaloosa? No, she was born in... Brookhaven, Mississippi.

ctx.x: Did... And what was your mother's name? My mother was named Ella Mae Bird. Ella Mae. Ella Mae.

Ella Mae Bird. Where? She was from Bugaloosa? No, she was born in... Brookhaven, Mississippi. Mm-hmm. And she met your father in Bugaloosa? I think she met him in Macomb somewhere. See, he played music too. What?
Do you know what did she meet?
